component.name: Renux
component.summary: A native client for Rex, the terminal multiplexer

description.p: Renux shows the sessions, tabs and panes of your Rex servers in a native window, with live terminals, floating panes, key bindings from your Rex config and the status of the programs and agents running in each pane.

ul.li: Several hosts side by side, found over Tailscale or added by address
Splits, floating layers, tabs and a command palette, driven by Rex's own actions
An activity panel and notifications for agents that need you
Themes that follow the host or the system, and your own custom themes
A see-through window, and custom shaders over the panes and the cursor
